desc: Ideation: derive formula using median of (pos[i] - i) and compute sum of absolute differences.
Parse N and S from input.
Collect zero-based indices of '1's into list `pos`.
Compute `vals = [pos[i] - i for i in range(len(pos))]`.
Find median `m` of `vals` (middle element after sorting).
Compute `answer = sum(abs(p - (m + i)) for i, p in enumerate(pos))`.
